DESCRIPTION: FIND: `dynamic_management.py` docstring, lines describing the immune review boundary. The statement `The immune layer review boundary is: _types.py + _immune.py + _manager.py.` is internally inconsistent with the same file’s own “Immune layer” import block, which also re-exports `FailureHandler` and `CorrelatedFailureModel` from `bench.dm._failure_handler`. This is not the same as prior findings about omission of `_failure_handler.py` alone; the missed defect is that the file defines two different immune-boundary taxonomies in one artifact: the module inventory/import surface treats `_failure_handler.py` as immune, while the review-boundary sentence excludes it. Evidence is present directly in the artifact text.
FIX: Replace the boundary sentence so it matches the actual immune import surface.
<<<<
The immune layer review boundary is: _types.py + _immune.py + _manager.py.
====
The immune layer review boundary is: _types.py + _immune.py + _failure_handler.py + _manager.py.
>>>>
FOLLOW: This correction propagates to any review instructions, module ownership docs, or task packets derived from this shim. In particular, interface summaries and review checklists must include `FailureHandler`/`CorrelatedFailureModel` under immune-boundary documentation; otherwise downstream reviewers will continue to scope the subsystem incorrectly. VERIFIED: TRUE

FINDING_ID: IM_F003
SEVERITY: 0.64
FLAW_CLASS: 2
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.61
DESCRIPTION: FIND: `dynamic_management.py`, orchestrator export block imports only `DynamicManager` from `bench.dm._manager`, despite the same docstring explicitly stating `_manager.py` contains `_REMEDIATION_CHAINS`, `apply_diagnosis`, `_apply_transform`, and `process_round`. Prior findings covered specific missing exports; the additional missed defect is that the import site itself contradicts the inventory structurally: a block labeled “Orchestrator” advertises module-level symbols but imports only the class, so the shim cannot satisfy its own “re-export” contract for manager-level functions/constants. Evidence: `from bench.dm._manager import DynamicManager` is the only orchestrator import in the artifact.
FIX: Import the documented manager-level API explicitly.
<<<<
from bench.dm._manager import DynamicManager  # noqa: F401
====
from bench.dm._manager import (  # noqa: F401
    DynamicManager,
    _REMEDIATION_CHAINS,
    apply_diagnosis,
    _apply_transform,
    process_round,
)
>>>>
FOLLOW: After this change, the shim’s public API expands and any `__all__` definition or compatibility tests must be updated to include these names. There is also a downstream import-risk check required: if `apply_diagnosis` / `process_round` are class methods rather than module-level functions, this import will fail and the docstring inventory is wrong. One of those two representations must be made authoritative. VERIFIED: TRUE
